name: TextField
purpose: Single-line text input with optional label, help text and error message.

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text above the input.

parts.name: input
parts.description: 40px tall, 12px horizontal padding, input fill, 1px border, large radius, placeholder in muted-foreground.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 12px muted-foreground help text below the input.

parts.name: error
parts.description: 12px destructive text, shown only when invalid.

variants.name: focus color
variants.description: Color of the 2px focus ring around the input.

layout: Vertical stack with 8px gap between parts.
responsive: Fills available width of its container.
accessibility: Description and error linked via described-by.

name: TextArea

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text.

parts.name: textarea
parts.description: 12px horizontal and 8px vertical padding, input fill, 1px border, large radius, vertically resizable.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 12px muted-foreground help text.

parts.name: error
parts.description: 12px destructive text when invalid.

accessibility: Same labelling and error association as TextField.

name: SearchField
purpose: Text input specialised for search, with a leading magnifier icon and a clear button.

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Full width; 40px left padding to clear the icon, 32px right padding for the clear button, 8px vertical padding, input fill, 1px border, large radius.

parts.name: search icon
parts.description: 16px magnifier inset 12px from the left, vertically centered, muted-foreground, non-interactive.

parts.name: clear button
parts.description: 14px X icon inset 8px from the right; hidden while input is empty.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 12px muted-foreground help text.

layout: Vertical stack with 8px gap; input wrapper positions icons absolutely over the input.
constraints: Default focus color is purple, unlike TextField.
accessibility: Search role; clear button has an accessible name; Escape clears.

name: NumberField

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text.

parts.name: group
parts.description: 40px tall horizontal group.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Flexible width, 12px horizontal padding, input fill, 1px border, rounded on left corners only.

parts.name: steppers
parts.description: Vertical pair attached to the input's right edge, bordered, rounded on right corners: '+' on top, '-' below separated by a 1px rule; secondary fill, muted on hover, 12px text.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 12px muted-foreground help text.

states: at min or max (corresponding stepper disabled)
layout: Vertical stack with 8px gap; steppers share the group's height equally.
constraints: Stepper glyphs are plain '+' and '-' characters.
accessibility: Spin button semantics; Up/Down arrows step; steppers have accessible names.

name: Select
purpose: Choose one option from a dropdown list.

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: 40px tall full-width button, 12px horizontal padding, input fill, 1px border, large radius; selected value or placeholder on the left, a 16px muted-foreground chevron on the right.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 12px muted-foreground help text.

parts.name: error
parts.description: 12px destructive text.

parts.name: popover
parts.description: Same width as the trigger; popover fill, 1px border, large radius, large shadow.

parts.name: option
parts.description: 12px by 8px padding, small radius, popover-foreground text.

variants.name: hover color
variants.description: Hovered/focused option shows light accent fill with accent text.

layout: Vertical stack with 8px gap; list scrolls beyond 15rem height, 4px inner padding.
constraints: Focus ring uses the neutral ring token, not an accent.
accessibility: Listbox popup with selected option; arrow keys and typeahead; Escape closes.

name: ComboBox
purpose: Text input with a filterable list of suggestions.

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Flexible width, 12px horizontal and 8px vertical padding, 36px right padding for the chevron, input fill, 1px border, large radius.

parts.name: chevron button
parts.description: 16px muted-foreground chevron inset 8px from the right.

parts.name: popover
parts.description: Same width as the field; popover fill, border, shadow.

parts.name: option
parts.description: 12px by 8px padding with light accent hover.

constraints: Defaults to purple for both hover and focus, unlike Select.
accessibility: Combobox role with listbox popup; arrow keys navigate; Enter selects.

name: Checkbox
purpose: Boolean choice that is independent of other choices.

parts.name: box
parts.description: 20px square, 2px border, small corner radius, input fill; contains a 12px white check mark that is invisible when unchecked.

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text, 8px to the right of the box.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Fill and border of the box when checked.

accessibility: Native checkbox semantics; Space toggles; label click toggles.

name: RadioGroup
purpose: Choose exactly one option from a small visible set.

parts.name: group label
parts.description: 14px foreground text above the options.

parts.name: radio
parts.description: 20px circle with 2px border and input fill; selected shows a 10px filled inner dot.

parts.name: radio label
parts.description: 14px foreground text, 8px right of the circle.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Border and inner dot color when selected; red uses the destructive token.

layout: Vertical list with 12px spacing between radios.
accessibility: Radio group role; arrow keys move selection; only the selected radio is in the tab order.

name: Switch

parts.name: track
parts.description: 48px wide, 24px tall pill with 1px border.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: 20px white circle with small shadow, 2px inset; slides 24px to the right when on.

parts.name: label
parts.description: 14px foreground text, 12px right of the track.

accessibility: Switch role with checked state; Space toggles.

name: Slider
purpose: Pick a numeric value on a continuous range.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Row with the label on the left and the current value on the right in 14px muted-foreground.

parts.name: track
parts.description: 8px tall fully rounded bar, secondary fill.

parts.name: fill
parts.description: Accent-colored portion from the start to the thumb.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: 20px white circle, 2px accent border, medium shadow; focus shows a 2px accent ring with 2px offset.

variants.name: show value
variants.description: Whether the value readout is displayed.

variants.name: value format
variants.description: Default readout is the number plus a percent sign.

layout: Header above a 24px tall row, 8px vertical gap.
constraints: Default readout appends a percent sign.
accessibility: Slider role with value; arrow keys step; Home/End jump.
